option_relations.rationale: The option describes a hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus, which is a manifestation or complication of the leaf disease, not the leaf disease itself.
The option describes a liver abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus, which is a manifestation or complication of the leaf disease, not the leaf disease itself.

The option 'Severe congenital neutropenia (SCN) with hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus' directly names the leaf disease 'Severe congenital neutropenia (ELANE mutation)' and includes a major complication/manifestation described in the vignette.

The option 'Immunodeficiency Disorder (ELANE mutation-associated)' is a broader category that encompasses 'Severe congenital neutropenia (ELANE mutation)' as SCN is an immunodeficiency disorder linked to ELANE mutations.
